transcript: You can now make 3D websites for absolutely free, and you don't even need to use Figma or learn how to code. So this tool is called Open Design. It's basically a free alternative to Claude Design, and this is how you can install and use it. So go to this website and download the desktop version. Now open the execution settings, and you can see all installed CLIs available to use. Now select Open Code and choose any free model to use. By the way, to install and set up Open Code for free, watch this reel. Once installed, select any free model, and just tell it what you want right inside the canvas, where you can keep prompting and keep refining your design until your design looks exactly how you want. Not only that, but you can also make app prototypes, slide decks, and even motion graphics, all in the same place for free. So if you want to try it out, just comment design, and I'll send you the link.
